subject: Community Preservation Project Funding Approvals
overview: The Community Preservation Committee introduced three new members and approved funding for four projects, including major allocations for affordable housing and school playground renovations.

items.title: Introduction of New Members
items.summary: The committee welcomed new members Ari Fishman, Craig Drennan, and Kayleen Foley representing various city boards.

items.title: Condon Shell Electrical Upgrade
items.summary: Approved a small grant of $3,276 to install additional outlets and safety lighting at the Condon Shell to better accommodate concerts and the farmer's market.

items.title: Walkland Court Funding Request
items.summary: Approved an $800,000 funding request for the Medford Housing Authority to complete the pre-development and construction financing for the redevelopment of senior and family housing units.

items.title: McGlynn School Playground Renovation
items.summary: Approved $400,000 for the second phase of construction for a universally accessible playground, with conditions requiring public access and prohibiting the use of CPA funds for artificial turf.

items.title: Thomas Brooks Park Archaeological Cap
items.summary: Approved a $5,000 small grant for the design of an archaeological cap and interpretive features to protect the historic house site from unauthorized excavation.

items.title: Planning Subcommittee Annual Celebration Update
items.summary: The committee received an update on planning for a five-year anniversary event tentatively scheduled for fall to recognize local CPA-funded projects.

items.title: 2023 Application Round Preview
items.summary: The chair reviewed the Eligibility Determination Forms received for the current funding round, noting several potential park, cemetery, and housing projects currently under consideration.
